data.narrative:
Biobot Analytics is a Series B-stage biotech and health company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis relies on a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Eikon Therapeutics) and 3 public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L). The private peer universe spans valuations from $539M to $10.3B, with a median of $3.5B.

Two triangulation methods apply to this target. Stage-progression analysis uses the $40M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage progression, implying a value of $76M. The peer-median approach directly references the $3.5B median valuation across the four same-sector peers, accounting for heterogeneity in the $539M–$10.3B range. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

These two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $65M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around the appropriate stage-adjusted multiple and peer comparability, particularly given the $539M–$10.3B dispersion in the private peer set. Stage-progression implies a more conservative entry point, while peer-median anchors to observed market transactions in the same sector.
